select date_format(d.day, '%m-%d') as date, coalesce(m.media_count, 0) as mediaCount, coalesce(u.ugc_count, 0) as ugcCount, coalesce(c.comment_count, 0) as commentCount from ( select date(create_time) as day from media where create_time >= date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day) union select date(create_time) as day from `comment` where create_time >= date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day) ) d left join ( select date(create_time) as day, count(1) as media_count from media where create_time >= date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day) group by date(create_time) ) m on m.day = d.day left join ( select date(create_time) as day, count(1) as ugc_count from media where type = 'ugc' and create_time >= date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day) group by date(create_time) ) u on u.day = d.day left join ( select date(create_time) as day, count(1) as comment_count from `comment` where create_time >= date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day) group by date(create_time) ) c on c.day = d.day order by d.day asc
select review_status as label, count(1) as value from ( select review_status from media union all select review_status from `comment` ) review_items group by review_status order by review_status asc
select type as label, count(1) as value from media group by type order by type asc
